newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rhone falls on Goldman Sachs downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Rhone falls on Goldman Sachs downgrade.

text.p: Shares in French chemicals company Rhone-Poulenc fell on Monday, following a downgrade by Goldman Sachs, fund managers said.

They said the U.S. brokerage marked down the stock to market performer, or neutral, from market outperformer or buy. A study by the broker on the European chemicals industry reckoned the possibilities for outperfomance were limited, particularly in bulk chemicals, given the unfavourable price environment.
Rhone was down 1.21 percent at 171.40 francs at 1114 GMT, while the market was up 0.90 percent.
